_doc: LaunchAgents whose program is ad-hoc signed or sits on a versioned path, and why that is fine. docs/tcc.md. A label not listed here makes `make tcc-check` fail. class: removable = the program reads or writes the external volume (docs/external-ssd.md), only behind scripts/lib/volume-gate.sh, and needs the Removable Volumes grant, answered once at the screen; launcher = file access is covered by herdr-core-launcher's Full Disk Access (the umbrella for LaunchAgents that call `op`; the herdr-core itself is Developer-ID signed Herdr Core.app and never listed); no-grant = the job touches no TCC-protected folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud, other apps' data).

com.iu.prometheus-dashboard-autodeploy.why: python3 in a Cellar path; works in ~/IuRoot only

com.iu.tool-checkout-deploy.why: python3 in a Cellar path; works in ~/IuRoot and ~/.local/state only (as prometheus-dashboard-autodeploy)

com.iu.teamchat-runtime-deploy.why: python3 in a Cellar path; works in ~/IuRoot only

com.iu.prometheus-vpn-watcher.why: uv python; touches the VPN client and ~/IuRoot only

com.jkrumm.modelpick-web.why: bun in a Cellar path; serves from ~/SourceRoot

com.jkrumm.weatherorb.serve.why: ad-hoc built openmeteo-api; data/ and products/ are symlinks onto the external volume since 2026-11-14 (job unloaded, V1 frozen: no live probe until it is revived)

com.jkrumm.weatherorb.watchdog.why: uv in a Cellar path; reads and writes data/, products/ and var/ entries that are symlinks onto the external volume since 2026-11-14 (job unloaded, V1 frozen)

com.jkrumm.weatherorb.worker-ingest.why: uv python; reads and writes data/, products/ and var/ entries that are symlinks onto the external volume since 2026-11-14 (job unloaded, V1 frozen)

com.jkrumm.weatherorb.worker-round.why: uv python; reads and writes data/, products/ and var/ entries that are symlinks onto the external volume since 2026-11-14 (job unloaded, V1 frozen)

com.jkrumm.collie.why: compiled bridge under ~/.local/share/collie; touches only its own config, state and log

homebrew.mxcl.sleepwatcher.why: runs ~/.sleep and ~/.wakeup, which touch nothing protected

com.jkrumm.ext-mirror.why: writes <volume>/mirror (rclone sync through hl), only behind scripts/lib/volume-gate.sh; a missing grant shows as 'skipped: volume unreadable' (exit 3, graded failing, retried hourly) and as the heartbeat's 36 h mirror age

com.jkrumm.devhost-health.why: the heartbeat reads the volume sentinel (external volume check); a missing grant shows as WARN unreadable, never a failure

sh.brew.ntfy-mac.why: notification relay; no file access outside its own state
